phase: frozen before candidate implementation and results
beneficiary: A researcher sharing a short retained camera interval can export only that selected segment's frames through the existing offline exporter and reopen a playable video, with exact source identity and an honest local-media timing sidecar.
entrypoint: python tools/export_session.py PACKAGE NEW_EXTERNAL_DIRECTORY --video-segment sources/.../segments/0001.mkv --video-start-ms INTEGER --video-end-ms INTEGER
source_fence: tools/export_session.py: additive arguments and early selected-video dispatch in main only; every existing function and whole-export branch preserved

preserve: existing whole-session export/wizard behavior, dependencies, workflows and required gates
selection: Require all three video options together and explicit output. Refuse --modalities or --verify in this mode rather than silently mix semantics.

Require finalized or finalized_recovered manifest; exact package-relative POSIX segment path matching one existing discover_streams MKV entry. Preserve descriptor source and stream IDs and literal path, including equal basenames under different streams.
Reject linked source/stream/segment path components, missing/unlisted/nonregular files and package escaping paths; do not traverse other package data to find a fallback.
Exactly one video stream; ignore audio/subtitle/other streams intentionally. No join across files.
interval: Nonnegative integer milliseconds with start < end; maximum selected interval 600000 ms.
Local media origin is first decoded video frame's best-effort presentation timestamp. It is not session time, wall time, checkpoint time or a cross-camera mapping.
Probe decoded frame presentation timestamps using FFprobe, preserving exact integer ticks and rational time base. Require strictly increasing known timestamps and known positive final-frame duration.

Select frames whose (presentation timestamp - first-frame timestamp) is >= start_ms and < end_ms, using exact rational arithmetic. Start is inclusive; end exclusive. Refuse empty selection or requested end past the last decoded frame's end.

Derive contiguous selected frame indices from that probe; FFmpeg trim by those frame indices and reset timestamps to the first selected frame. Preserve all selected source frame indices/ticks in the sidecar. No timestamp interpolation or synthetic frames.
encoding: Produce video-only clip.mp4 using explicit H.264/yuv420p settings, single encoder thread and passthrough frame timing. This is a lossy review copy, not archival replacement or pixel-identical original.
Admit even positive source dimensions up to3840x2160. Do not resize, crop, rotate, join or infer spatial calibration; auto-rotation disabled.

Probe the completed clip before success: exactly one H.264 video stream, unchanged dimensions, positive output frames, exact selected frame count and zero-based first presentation time. Sidecar records actual output frame ticks/time base and duration separately from requested source interval.

Keep source input bytes unchanged; hash selected source and relevant manifest/stream metadata before and after processing. Refuse success on observed source changes. No claim of atomic protection against arbitrary concurrent external rewriting.
outputs: Explicit destination must be absent and resolve outside the selected package; existing files/directories and path aliases into package are refused before output writes.

Admit input/interval/tools before creating destination. Create new output directory exclusively. Retain partial failed output for diagnosis, with no success export_manifest.json and an actionable nonzero CLI result.

Write the video under an incomplete name first; rename to clip.mp4 only after output checks and source recheck. Write versioned capture.video_clip_export/1 export_manifest.json last; this file is the completion record.

Completion includes original package state, source/stream/path, input and output byte/hash pins, requested half-open local interval, exact source timestamp origin and selected frame ticks, encoder/probe command/version, output facts and explicit limitations. No integrity/clinical/hardware/truth assurance.

CLI all-option/type/range/empty/end-beyond/missing/unlisted/invalid-media/nonfinal/linked/path-alias/occupied-output/tool-failure controls; keep every package/input byte and unrelated destination sentinel exact.
Actual late encoder/output failure leaves no success manifest; ordinary new-destination retry succeeds.
